channels.title: Public channels
channels.description: Usernames or links of PUBLIC Telegram channels, one per line. Accepted forms: `telegram`, `@durov`, `https://t.me/bbcrussian`, `https://t.me/s/contest`. Private channels, invite links (`t.me/+...`) and groups without a public preview are skipped and never charged. You can add hundreds of channels in one run.

maxMessages.title: Max messages per channel
maxMessages.description: Stop after this many messages for each channel (newest first). Messages that do not pass your filters or date range do not count. Free plan: capped at 10 per channel.

dateFrom.title: Only messages from (date)
dateFrom.description: Backfill start: skip messages older than this. Accepts `2026-09-01`, an ISO timestamp, or a relative value such as `7 days` or `2 weeks`. Leave empty to go back as far as `maxMessages` allows (Telegram keeps the complete channel history in the preview).

dateTo.title: Only messages until (date)
dateTo.description: Backfill end (inclusive): skip messages newer than this. A date without time means the end of that day (UTC). The Actor jumps straight to that point of the archive instead of walking from the newest message.

incremental.title: Incremental mode (only new messages)
incremental.description: Remember the last message id seen per channel in a named key-value store and, on the next run, return only newer messages (oldest first). The first run returns the latest `maxMessages` and records the starting point. Ideal for scheduled monitoring: if more new messages than `maxMessages` are waiting, the next run continues exactly where this one stopped.

stateStoreName.title: Incremental state store name
stateStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store that remembers the last message id per channel. Use a different name for each independent monitoring job (for example one per schedule).

includeKeywords.title: Keywords to include
includeKeywords.description: Keep only messages whose text, link preview or poll question contains at least one of these words or phrases (case-insensitive).

excludeKeywords.title: Keywords to exclude
excludeKeywords.description: Drop messages that contain any of these words or phrases (case-insensitive). Exclusion wins over inclusion.

includeRegex.title: Regex to include
includeRegex.description: JavaScript regular expression (case-insensitive). A message is kept if it matches this expression or one of the include keywords. Example: `\b(airdrop|listing)\b`.

excludeRegex.title: Regex to exclude
excludeRegex.description: JavaScript regular expression (case-insensitive). Messages that match are dropped. Example: `^(ad|sponsored)\b`.

extractLinks.title: Extract links, mentions and hashtags
extractLinks.description: Add `links` (external URLs in the text), `mentions` (@usernames) and `hashtags` arrays to every message.

includeHtml.title: Include formatted HTML
includeHtml.description: Keep the message's formatting (bold, italics, links, quotes) as clean HTML in the `html` field next to the plain `text`. Turn off for smaller rows.

includeServiceMessages.title: Include service messages
includeServiceMessages.description: Also return system messages such as `pinned a message` or `channel name was changed`. Off by default.

maxConcurrency.title: Channels in parallel
maxConcurrency.description: How many channels are scraped at the same time. 5 is polite and fast; lower it if you see rate-limit warnings.

maxPagesPerChannel.title: Safety limit: pages per channel
maxPagesPerChannel.description: Each page holds up to 20 messages. This caps how deep the Actor walks into a channel's history when your filters match rarely. Raise it for very deep keyword searches.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy (optional)
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed in normal use. If Telegram rate-limits your runs, enable Apify datacenter proxy: the Actor rotates the proxy session automatically after a 429.
